description: This file 'ControlService.h' defines the interface and classes for the ControlService plugin within the WPEFramework namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, event handlers, and associated enums, focusing on control and remote management functionalities. It primarily provides declarations with no implementation details, designed for integration in a larger C++ project that deals with remote control and device communication.
